Sunny Optical Technology (Group) Company Limited (the “Company”                舜 宇 光 學 科 技（ 集 團 ）有 限 公 司（「 本 公 司 」或
or “Sunny Optical Technology”, together with its subsidiaries, the             「舜宇光學科技」，連同其附屬公司「本集團」）
“Group”) (Stock Code: 2382.HK) is a global leading manufacturer of             （股份代號：2382.HK），是全球領先的大規模
integrated optical products with large-scale and a globally competitive        綜合光學產品製造商及具備國際競爭力的智能
provider of intelligent optical system solutions (whole device). The           光學系統方案（整機）解決商。本集團從事設
Group is engaged in the design, research and development (“R&D”),              計、研究與開發（「研發」）、生產及銷售綜合
production and sales of integrated optical products and intelligent            光學產品及智能光學系統方案（整機），並深度
optical system solutions (whole device). By deeply integrating cutting-        融合光學、電子、算法、軟件、機械及人工智
edge technologies such as optics, electronics, algorithms, software,           能（「AI」）等前沿技術，助力全球客戶在智能手

clients to achieve innovative breakthroughs and value growth across            IoT」）及精密光學等應用領域實現創新突破及
application fields including smartphones, vehicles, extended reality           價值增長。
(“XR”), pan Internet of things (“Pan-IoT”) and precision optics.

MARKET REVIEW                                                               市場回顧

In 2025, the global economy progressed with twists and turns amid           二零二五年，全球經濟在貿易政策不確定性、

Risk Management Policy Framework                                                         風險管理政策框架

Effective risk management and internal control systems are critical in                   有效的風險管理及內部監控系統對實現本集團
achieving the Group’s strategic objectives. The Group has established                    的戰略目標至關重要。本集團已制定風險管理
a risk management policy framework, which was audited and                                政策框架，由董事會及審核委員會審核通過，
approved by the Board and the Audit Committee, and executed by the                       並由風險管理工作小組執行，授權本集團採用
Risk Management Group. It authorizes the Group to take a consistent                      貫徹一致及有效的方針，充分管理與戰略、財
and effective approach applied across the Group to fully manage the                      務、運營、市場及符合上市規則相關的風險。
risks associated with strategies, financial, operations, market and
compliance with the Listing Rules.

the Whistleblowing Instructions and Rewards and Protection                 制度。本公司已制定嚴格的保密措施和程序，

RESTRICTED SHARE AWARD SCHEME                                                   限制性股份獎勵計劃

On 22 March 2010 (the “Adoption Date”), the Board adopted                       於二零一零年三月二十二日（「採納日期」），董
the Restricted Share Award Scheme. Pursuant to the Restricted                   事會採納限制性股份獎勵計劃。根據限制性股
Share Award Scheme, the Directors, employees, officers, agents                  份獎勵計劃，本公司及其附屬公司之董事、僱
and consultants of the Company and its subsidiaries are entitled to             員、高級職員、代理及顧問均有權參與是項計
participate in this scheme.                                                     劃。


The purposes of the Restricted Share Award Scheme are to assist the             限制性股份獎勵計劃之目的為協助本公司吸納

     taxable profits against which to utilise the benefits of the              撥回時確認。
     temporary differences and they are expected to reverse in the
     foreseeable future.


     The carrying amount of deferred tax assets is reviewed at the             遞延稅項資產的賬面值於各報告期末
     end of each reporting period and reduced to the extent that               進行審閱，並會削減至不再可能有足
     it is no longer probable that sufficient taxable profits will be          夠應課稅溢利用於收回全部或部分相
     available to allow all or part of the asset to be recovered.              關資產為止。


     Deferred tax assets and liabilities are measured at the tax               遞延稅項資產及負債按償還負債或變
     rates that are expected to apply in the period in which the               現資產的期間內預期適用之稅率，根
     liability is settled or the asset is realised, based on tax rate          據報告期末已頒佈或實質頒佈的稅率
     (and tax laws) that have been enacted or substantively                    （及稅法）計算。
     enacted by the end of the reporting period.


     The measurement of deferred tax liabilities and assets reflects           遞延稅項負債及資產之計量反映按照
     the tax consequences that would follow from the manner in                 本集團所預期方式於報告期末可收回
     which the Group expects, at the end of the reporting period,              或結算其資產及負債賬面值將出現之
     to recover or settle the carrying amount of its assets and                稅務後果。
     liabilities.

                  event;                                                              行為；

                  consider; or

   c. F a i r v a l u e m e a s u r e m e n t s o f f i n a n c i a l          c. 金融工具的公允值計量
      instruments

       The Group’s management is responsible for the fair value                  本集團管理層負責財務報告所需資產
       measurements of assets and liabilities required for financial             及負債的公允值計量。管理層就該等
       reporting purposes. The management reports directly to the                公允值計量直接向董事會匯報。
       board of directors for these fair value measurements.


       In estimating the fair value, the Group uses market-observable            估算公允值時，本集團在可用範圍內
       data to the extent it is available. For instruments with                  採用市場可觀察數據。對於第三級下
       significant unobservable inputs under Level 3, the Group will             具有重大不可觀察輸入數據的工具，
       normally engage external valuation experts with the recognised            本集團通常委聘具有獲認可專業資格
       professional qualifications to perform the valuations.                    的外部估值專家進行估值。


       Fair values are categorised into different fair value hierarchy           公允值根據估值法所用的輸入數據分
       based on the inputs used in the valuation techniques as                   為以下不同的公允值等級：
       follows:


       •   Level 1 fair value measurements are those derived from                •   第一級公允值計量是指根據活躍市
           quoted prices (unadjusted) in active markets for identical                場中相同資產或負債的報價（未經
           assets or liabilities;                                                    調整）得出的公允值；


       •   Level 2 fair value measurements are those derived from                •   第二級公允值計量是指根據除第一
           inputs other than quoted prices included within Level 1                   級所包含的報價以外的、可直接
           that are observable for the asset or liability, either directly           （即價格）或間接（即由價格推導）
           (i.e. as prices) or indirectly (i.e. derived from prices);                觀察的資產或負債輸入數據得出的
                                                                                     公允值；


       •   Level 3 fair value measurements are those derived                     •   第三級公允值計量是指使用估值法
           from valuation techniques for which the lowest level                      得出的公允值，其中對公允值計量
           input that is significant to the fair value measurement is                具有重大影響的最低層次輸入數據
           unobservable (significant unobservable input).                            是不可觀察的（重大不可觀察輸入
                                                                                     數據）。
